chunks.heading: Market contract
chunks.body: Ostium identifies pair 10 as SPX/USD in the indices group and presents it as US500/USD in the trading interface. Current documentation publishes maximum leverage of 200x; this venue ceiling is not a safe sizing recommendation.

chunks.heading: Fees
chunks.body: US500/USD has a documented opening fee of 3 basis points and no closing fee. Entry and exit still execute at bid and ask, and an oracle request costs 0.10 USDC unless refunded after a successful full close.

chunks.heading: Schedule and rollover
chunks.body: The documented index schedule runs Sunday 18:00 through Friday 17:00 Eastern Time with a daily 17:00-18:00 break. Rollover accrues continuously per block and indices use SOFR plus a carry premium.

chunks.heading: Read-only probe warning
chunks.body: The public read-only subgraph returned pair 10 as SPX/USD. Raw subgraph numeric fields are scaled and getPairs derives normalized values, so raw values must never be fed directly into sizing.
